unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
rate_limited: You're going a little fast. Please wait a moment and try again.
no_organization: Finish setting up your company first.
not_found: We couldn't find what you were looking for.
email_taken: An account with this email already exists. Try signing in instead.
invalid_credentials: That email and password don't match. Please try again.
invalid_token: This link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
password_too_weak: Include at least one letter and one number.
ai_not_configured: Your AI team needs an AI provider. An admin can add one under Settings → AI Team.
ai_budget_exceeded: Your AI allowance for this month is used up. Upgrade your plan or raise the limit in Settings → Billing.
ai_failed: Your AI team couldn't finish this request. Please try again.
integration_not_configured: This connection isn't available yet. We'll let you know as soon as it is.
integration_expired: Your connection expired. Reconnect it to continue publishing.
integration_error: We couldn't complete the connection. Please try again.
oauth_denied: The connection was cancelled. You can try again whenever you're ready.
oauth_state: The connection attempt timed out. Please try again.
website_unreachable: We couldn't open that website. Check the address and try again.
plan_limit: Your current plan doesn't include this. Upgrade to unlock it.
last_owner: Every organization needs at least one owner.
billing_not_configured: Online billing isn't set up yet. Contact us to change your plan.
cannot_publish: This post can't be published until a connected account is available for its channel.
requires_approval: This needs approval before it can go out.
invalid_transition: That change isn't possible from the current status.
already_member: That person is already on your team.

page.title: This page hit a snag
page.body: We've logged the problem. You can try again, or head back home.
page.notFoundBody: The link may be broken or the page may have moved.
page.forbiddenBody: Ask an admin on your team if you need access.

no_accounts: We didn't find a business account on that sign-in. Make sure you manage the page or profile, then try again.
test_post_needs_media: This platform needs an image or video to publish; test publishing on Facebook or LinkedIn.

linkedin_invalid_scope: We couldn't finish connecting LinkedIn because a permission isn't enabled in the app yet.
no_page_permission: Meta is connected, but no Page access was granted yet, so there are no Pages or Instagram accounts to manage.
capability_unavailable: This feature isn't available for this account yet.
instagram_personal_account: Automatic publishing requires an Instagram professional account (Business or Creator). Switch the account to Business or Creator in the Instagram app, then connect again.
instagram_invalid_scope: We couldn't finish connecting Instagram because a permission isn't enabled in the app yet.
content_ai_not_configured: OpenAI generation isn't set up yet.
image_not_configured: Image generation isn't set up yet.
image_limit: You've used this month's design generations for your plan. Upgrade or wait for next month.
image_failed: We couldn't create the design. Your content is saved — you can try again.
image_refused: This design request couldn't be created under the image provider's safety rules. Try describing it differently.
image_rate_limited: The image service is busy. Try again in a minute.
calendar_not_connected: Connect a calendar to complete the booking. No meeting was booked.
calendar_no_free_slots: Your calendar has no free working-hour slots in the next 10 days.

policy_locked: Pricing, discounts, proposals and contract language always need approval.
video_not_configured: Automatic video generation isn't connected yet.
nothing_due: There are no due follow-ups to prepare.
email_not_configured: Email isn't set up for this installation yet, so the message couldn't be sent.
whatsapp_test_recipient_missing: Set WHATSAPP_TEST_RECIPIENT before sending a test WhatsApp.

document_empty: No readable text was found in this document.
requires_integration: This needs an official connection to the platform — public data only isn't enough.
strategy_needs_answers: Answer a few strategy questions first, or build the strategy from your data.
